retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 16 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge, which is the surprise of the batch. The English article, at revision 1374738410, is two hundred and twenty-six kilobytes and its background section is titled "Background of discontent with General National Congress": it argues the war of 2014 out of the GNC elected in 2012, the failure of its parties to compromise, the political isolation law and the extension of its own mandate — and **it never argues a line back to the war of 2011**, which this atlas holds as `libyan-civil-war`. The only mention of the earlier war is a hatnote distinguishing the two articles, and a hatnote is not a claim. Writing the obvious edge would be this run's inference. It waits on a page that argues the second Libyan war out of the first.
